verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, a built-in AI agent that takes a production error and does the work itself: it writes a tested fix and opens a pull request for you to review and approve. That is genuine delegation to an in-product assistant. The delegable task, however, is narrowly scoped to error remediation. Missing for 10: evidence of delegating tasks beyond error-to-PR fixes (e.g. triage, querying, configuration), detailed docs on how users invoke or steer Resolve, independent or hands-on corroboration.
